swimming_pool.evidence: Large rectangular bright turquoise water surface with a concrete deck and lounge chairs, just west of the central house.

detached_structure.evidence: Small square structure with a lighter roof northwest of the house near the lot's upper edge, possibly a playhouse or shed. A blue tarp-like object sits beside the house.

signals.notes: Central house has a large in-ground pool in the west yard and a blue cover or tarp at the southwest corner of the house. The dark gray roof looks uniform, and a dark vehicle is parked at the east end of the driveway.
